description: This circular walk explores the area around the settlements of Maxey and Market Deeping in Cambridgeshire. Along the way you'll enjoy waterside walks along the River Welland and the Maxey Cut. It's a flat route with some fine views of the surrounding countryside to enjoy. In Maxey you can enjoy some refreshments at the Blue Bell pub which dates to the 19th century. They are dog friendly and can be found on the High Street at postcode PE6 9EE.
